metadata.title: Hyperbolic comparison and rigidity for the hyperspherical radius
metadata.abstract: We prove Gromov's hyperbolic hyperspherical radius comparison and rigidity conjectures in all dimensions $n\ge3$, without the spin assumption. Let $(X^n, g)$ be a smooth, oriented, connected, compact Riemannian manifold with nonempty smooth connected boundary $S$. If ${\rm Sc}_g\ge -n(n-1)$ and $H_S\ge (n-1)\coth R$ for some $R>0$, then ${\rm Rad}(S,g_S)\le\sinh R$, with equality if and only if $(X^n,g)$ is isometric to the closed hyperbolic geodesic ball of radius $R$. Under the same curvature bounds, every smooth $1$-Lipschitz map of nonzero degree from $S$ to the boundary of the hyperbolic geodesic ball of radius $R$ extends to an isometry of the fillings. Here, $g_S$ is the induced boundary metric, $H_S$ is the mean curvature of $S$ with respect to the outward unit normal, and ${\rm Rad}(S,g_S)$ denotes the hyperspherical radius.

analysis.workSummary: 在任意 n≥3、无 spin 假设下，以标量曲率下界 −n(n−1) 和边界平均曲率下界 (n−1)coth R 推出边界超球半径≤sinh R，并以等号刻画双曲测地球。
techniques: 奇点维数下降与余项刚性
analysis.breakthrough: 声称解决 Gromov 的双曲超球半径比较与刚性，并给出满足条件的边界映射延拓为等距的强结论。
analysis.limitations: 要求定向、紧致和非空光滑连通边界；平均曲率使用外法向。上确界不要求取得，证明借助加权曲率及既有任意维奇点下降工具。已读主定理、推论与概要，未逐步审读完整 Jang 图构造和外部下降定理。
analysis.aiEvidence: 作者披露 ChatGPT 先建议一条限于三至七维的曲折路线，之后融入作者想法经多轮讨论扩展至任意维；模型协助中间论证探索、模型计算及查找证明缺口，作者指挥讨论并独立复核写稿。
analysis.aiEvidenceSource: https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.28450v1 · 第4页 Disclosure on AI assistance

analysis.priorityReason: 无 spin 且任意维的标量曲率比较结果，优先阅读主证明的维数处理。
